heading:
Everyday creative work
shouldn’t be hard.
lead: Most people don’t want a design studio. They want one correct file, now - without breaking the style, without waiting on someone and without being asked to sign up and pay before they can start. Lolly can help.

frustrations.title: Aesthetic anxiety
frustrations.desc: The quiet fear of picking the wrong colour or font. Over-thinking what was meant to be simple.

frustrations.title: The bottleneck
frustrations.desc: Every asset stuck with a busy human queue, a slow tool, or one more approval.

frustrations.title: The toll gate
frustrations.desc: An account before you can start, a subscription that outlives the job, and predatory pricing ladders holding your work hostage.

matrix.pain: Sign in before you are allowed to make anything.
matrix.relief: Open it and start. There is no account.

matrix.pain: Your work lives where you don't get a vote: the rules can change, and you find out later.
matrix.relief: Your work stays with you. Every choice is yours, and you can exit or pivot to anything you like.

matrix.pain: A subscription that keeps charging long after the job is done.
matrix.relief: Lolly is 100% free, forever: what has been released can never be taken back from you.

matrix.pain: The template that is almost right, but the part you need is locked behind an upgrade.
matrix.relief: What should change is yours to change; what should not is already handled.

matrix.pain: Finish the design, then find the download costs extra.
matrix.relief: Every export is included: print-quality PDF, sharp SVG, video, all of it.

matrix.pain: Pay the AI again for something it already made, and get it back slightly different.
matrix.relief: How you use AI is your choice. Identical and consistent, different when you decide - for free.

matrix.pain: Email a brief to someone, wait days, all for content you know the details of.
matrix.relief: Fill in a few fields. The finished file is ready in seconds.

matrix.pain: Guess at the right font, boilerplate, and rules - and hope it passes a review.
matrix.relief: Constraints baked into the tool. They bend, not break.

matrix.pain: Re-make the same video, graphic, or audio file many times by hand.
matrix.relief: Paste a spreadsheet. Get all finished, print-ready files at once.

matrix.pain: “Which version is the latest?” - hunting through Slack threads and shared drives.
matrix.relief: The file is a link. Same inputs, same file, every single time.
